final_message:
I produced a tracked-changes redline of Pinnacle's draft v1.0 (683 insertions, 475 deletions), and rejecting every change gives back the original text exactly. It moves the draft to Ceritas's playbook positions and the terms of the signed MSA, and adds Section 17 (complaints), Annexes C, D and F, renames the subcontractor list Annex E, and adds a signature block for Ceritas Ireland.
I also produced a clause-by-clause issues memo with 53 deviations scored under the risk rubric (22 Critical, 19 High, 9 Medium, 3 Low); the file had no standard template, inspection history or regulatory cross-reference matrix, so the wording follows the playbook and MSA, and likelihood scores use rubric defaults.
